transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, next Thursday we'll be conducting our student-family reunification exercise following a simulated building evacuation. Before I can sign off on the final operating plan and we send the notice to families, I need to check in with each of you per our planning routine. The current draft has the gymnasium as our reunification site, a single transportation wave, an on-site medication table, and English-only pickup forms. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you — nurse, facilities, transportation, and family liaison — so we can identify any concerns before I approve. Who would like to start?

My current health-plan list identifies four students whose emergency medications must remain in temperature-controlled storage at all times. The nurse's office refrigerator is the only approved storage location for these medications during the exercise. I confirmed this requirement while reviewing the health plans this week, but the draft plan still lists an on-site medication table, which would not meet the temperature-controlled storage requirement for these students.
